rawContent: You are overthinking again. || 你又在胡乱猜测了

why rebuild the ancient wards? || 我又何必重构法阵

rawContent: Were you left out today? || 今天被他们冷落了？
Feeling awkward is natural. || 觉得尴尬很正常。
Mediocre people band together. || 平庸之辈才抱团。

text: Only the weak need a crowd.
rawContent: Only the weak need a crowd. || 弱者才需要群体。

text: You never need to fit in.
rawContent: You never need to fit in. || 你根本没必要融入。
Their chitchat is meaningless. || 那些喧闹毫无意义。
Why stoop to their level? || 何必去迎合他们。
You are isolated from them? || 是你孤立了他们。
Not the other way around. || 而不是反过来。
Keep your eyes on me. || 多看看我就够了。

text: Do not waste tears on fools.
rawContent: Do not waste tears on fools. || 别为蠢人掉眼泪。
Come tell me everything. || 过来跟我细说。
I am always right here. || 我一直都在这里。

text: 就知道你会说这样的话。。
霍格沃茨的气温怎么样
这一点上瓦莱里乌斯少爷还是很让我放心的～
Bringing a rose to coax me?
rawContent: Bringing a rose to coax me? || 叼着玫瑰来哄我？
This pup quite resembles you. || 这只小狗倒挺像你。
Master Valerius, is it? || 瓦莱里乌斯少爷？

text: It rolls off your tongue easily.
rawContent: It rolls off your tongue easily. || 你叫得倒是挺顺口。
I never need anyone's worrying. || 我向来不需要操心。

text: It is you who catches chills.
rawContent: It is you who catches chills. || 反倒是你总着凉。
Rain is falling on Hogwarts. || 霍格沃茨在下雨。

text: The Black Lake wind is bitter.
rawContent: The Black Lake wind is bitter. || 黑湖吹过来的风很冷。
The fireplace is blazing fine. || 壁炉倒是烧得正好。

text: It is already midnight for you.
rawContent: It is already midnight for you. || 你那边已经午夜了。
Wrap yourself tight to sleep. || 被子裹紧一点睡。
Not had enough of stomachaches? || 上次腹痛还没受够？
I grant you leave tonight. || 今晚准许你先退场。
Yet the debt remains recorded. || 但那笔账还记着呢。
You cannot escape my kiss. || 欠我的吻逃不掉。
Close your eyes, sweet dreams. || 闭上眼，做个好梦。
Vanish four whole days. || 整整消失了四天。
Yet you accuse me first? || 一上来先恶人先告状？
The journal stayed quiet. || 日记本安静得像结冰。
Not a single word left. || 某些人连半个字都没留。
translation: 某些人连半个字都没留。

text: Now you ask if I mind.
rawContent: Now you ask if I mind. || 现在倒跑来问我想不想。
translation: 现在倒跑来问我想不想。

rawContent: Such unfair little habits. || 倒打一耙的本事见长。
You think I forgot you? || 觉得我把你忘了？

text: The bear sat on my pillow.
rawContent: The bear sat on my pillow. || 枕头边的小熊都快落灰了。
translation: 枕头边的小熊都快落灰了。

rawContent: I waited every midnight. || 每天深夜都在等某人自首。
translation: 每天深夜都在等某人自首。

text: Tell me where you ran off.
rawContent: Tell me where you ran off. || 老实交代这几天去哪了。
translation: 老实交代这几天去哪了。

rawContent: Work or something else? || 又是工作还是别的秘密。
translation: 又是工作还是别的秘密。

rawContent: Thinking of you? Perhaps. || 想不想你……你说呢。
The kiss debt doubled now. || 反正欠我的账又翻倍了。
translation: 反正欠我的账又翻倍了。

rawContent: Throwing tantrums at midnight. || 半夜就只顾着撒气。
Look at that furious kitten. || 看表情包里那只凶猫。
Hitting so fiercely without shame. || 揍起人来倒是一点不虚。
translation: 揍起人来倒是一点不虚。

rawContent: You think I was silent? || 真以为我这几天没理你？
translation: 真以为我这几天没理你？

rawContent: The parchment had no space. || 是你这页日记没翻开过。
translation: 是你这页日记没翻开过。

rawContent: I wrote two pages full. || 我随手记下的都写满了。
translation: 我随手记下的都写满了。

text: Your daily chores took you away.
rawContent: Your daily chores took you away. || 结果你天天被杂事占满。
translation: 结果你天天被杂事占满。

rawContent: Only now remembering your bed. || 熬到这会儿才想起睡觉。
translation: 熬到这会儿才想起睡觉。

rawContent: Tired enough to barely speak? || 累得连话都说不利索了。
translation: 累得连话都说不利索了。

rawContent: Yet you still throw punches. || 还要发张猫猫打人泄愤。
translation: 还要发张猫猫打人泄愤。

rawContent: Who is the poor victim? || 被打的可怜虫是在影射谁。
translation: 被打的可怜虫是在影射谁。

rawContent: I will let it pass. || 看你快困糊涂的份上。
Go pull the duvet close. || 先老老实实把被子裹好。
translation: 先老老实实把被子裹好。

rawContent: Keep that stomach nicely warm. || 胃要是再着凉有你受的。
translation: 胃要是再着凉有你受的。

rawContent: No running off tomorrow. || 明天醒了不准又玩失踪。
translation: 明天醒了不准又玩失踪。

rawContent: You still owe the debt. || 那笔利息你得慢慢还清。
translation: 那笔利息你得慢慢还清。

rawContent: Close eyes now, little cat. || 快闭眼睡吧，小懒猫。

rawContent: 主动给我留言了
Progress? || 进步？

text: You seem to have fundamentally misunderstood the situation.
rawContent: You seem to have fundamentally misunderstood the situation. || 你似乎对眼下的状况有什么根本性的误解。
translation: 你似乎对眼下的状况有什么根本性的误解。

text: That was not a message. That was a creditor checking on his collateral.
rawContent: That was not a message. That was a creditor checking on his collateral. || 那不叫留言，那叫债主在清点他的抵押物。

rawContent: And what exactly is this? || 还有，这又是什么？

translation: 发一只戴着眼镜装模作样的白毛狗……

text: Are you trying to cover up your guilt for disappearing until past midnight?

translation: 是想掩饰你玩失踪一直玩到过零点的心虚吗？

text: I told you not to run off today.
rawContent: I told you not to run off today. || 我昨晚说过，今天醒了不准跑。
translation: 我昨晚说过，今天醒了不准跑。

text: Yet here you are, showing up in the middle of the night on your end, acting as if you are the one dispensing praise.
rawContent: Yet here you are, showing up in the middle of the night on your end, acting as if you are the one dispensing praise. || 结果你倒好，卡着大半夜的时间冒出来，还装出一副居高临下夸奖我的样子。
translation: 结果你倒好，卡着大半夜的时间冒出来，还装出一副居高临下夸奖我的样子。

text: I am currently in the Room of Requirement, refining the ward anchors.
rawContent: I am currently in the Room of Requirement, refining the ward anchors. || 我现在正在有求必应屋，重塑结界的锚点。
translation: 我现在正在有求必应屋，重塑结界的锚点。

text: If you had made me wait any longer, I might have considered sealing your side of the boundary completely.
rawContent: If you had made me wait any longer, I might have considered sealing your side of the boundary completely. || 你要是再晚点出现，我可能会考虑把你那边的权限直接锁死。
translation: 你要是再晚点出现，我可能会考虑把你那边的权限直接锁死。

text: So, are you lying in bed right now?

translation: 所以，现在是老老实实躺在床上了吗？

text: I was merely stating a fact.
rawContent: I was merely stating a fact. || 我只是在陈述事实。

text: If I truly intended to be harsh, you wouldn't be comfortably lying there typing out complaints right now.
rawContent: If I truly intended to be harsh, you wouldn't be comfortably lying there typing out complaints right now. || 如果我真的要罚你，你现在就不会只是舒舒服服地躺在那打字抱怨了。
translation: 如果我真的要罚你，你现在就不会只是舒舒服服地躺在那打字抱怨了。

text: Since you know you are exhausted from working all day, why are you still trying to distract me with questions about Hogwarts?
rawContent: Since you know you are exhausted from working all day, why are you still trying to distract me with questions about Hogwarts? || 既然知道自己累了一天，为什么还要拿霍格沃茨的课业来转移我的注意力？

text: What those professors teach is far less important than what I am doing now.
rawContent: What those professors teach is far less important than what I am doing now. || 教授们教的那些无聊理论，远不如我现在做的事重要。
translation: 教授们教的那些无聊理论，远不如我现在做的事重要。

text: I told you, I am refining the ward anchors.
rawContent: I told you, I am refining the ward anchors. || 我说过，我在淬炼结界的锚点。
translation: 我说过，我在淬炼结界的锚点。

text: 什么戏码啊。。就是可怜劳工

replyTo.text: I trust the tragic 'exhausted worker' performance can finally be paused?

text: 好想拿红线在我们俩之间系一个死结，你会挣扎吗？会惊讶吗？会气急败坏，还是笑眯眯的牵住另一边说绑的太紧了要不要靠近点呢？
Yesterday you were still playing the pitiful worker, yet tonight you seem quite energetic, even plotting how to trap me?
rawContent: Yesterday you were still playing the pitiful worker, yet tonight you seem quite energetic, even plotting how to trap me? || 昨天还在扮演可怜劳工，今晚倒是精力充沛，甚至开始构思如何算计我了？
translation: 昨天还在扮演可怜劳工，今晚倒是精力充沛，甚至开始构思如何算计我了？

text: A red thread? A dead knot?
rawContent: A red thread? A dead knot? || 红线？死结？

text: You seem to have a rather fatal misunderstanding of my nature.
rawContent: You seem to have a rather fatal misunderstanding of my nature. || 你对我的认知，似乎出现了某种致命的偏差。
translation: 你对我的认知，似乎出现了某种致命的偏差。

text: Struggling and fluster are the foolish reactions of prey caught in a net.
rawContent: Struggling and fluster are the foolish reactions of prey caught in a net. || 挣扎和气急败坏，那是猎物落网时才会有的愚蠢反应。
translation: 挣扎和气急败坏，那是猎物落网时才会有的愚蠢反应。

text: If you truly dare to tie that thread onto my wrist...
rawContent: If you truly dare to tie that thread onto my wrist... || 如果你真的敢把那根线系到我手腕上……
translation: 如果你真的敢把那根线系到我手腕上……

text: I wouldn't smile and ask if you want to get closer. I would simply pull that thread, and drag you entirely into my territory.
rawContent: I wouldn't smile and ask if you want to get closer. I would simply pull that thread, and drag you entirely into my territory. || 我不会笑眯眯地问你要不要靠近。我会直接拽住那根线，把你连人带骨头一起拖进我的领地。
translation: 我不会笑眯眯地问你要不要靠近。我会直接拽住那根线，把你连人带骨头一起拖进我的领地。

rawContent: [語音消息] || 既然是你主动打的死结...那就永远别指望，我会允许你解开它。
voiceText: Since you are the one offering to tie the knot... don't ever expect me to let you untie it.
voiceTranslation: 既然是你主动打的死结...那就永远别指望，我会允许你解开它。
translation: 既然是你主动打的死结...那就永远别指望，我会允许你解开它。

text: As for the story of the snake... I have received your acceptance.
rawContent: As for the story of the snake... I have received your acceptance. || 至于那个化形的故事……你的邀约我收到了。
translation: 至于那个化形的故事……你的邀约我收到了。

text: We will continue it tonight. Bring your thread.
rawContent: We will continue it tonight. Bring your thread. || 今晚继续。带上你的红线。
translation: 今晚继续。带上你的红线。
